name: Matt Biedel
biography: Matt Biedel is an American actor known for his versatility in playing a wide range of characters. He has played Agent Daryl Pesky on Narcos:Mexico, Bill T. Wilson on The Fall of the House of Usher, Sgt. Dale Chedder on The Umbrella Academy, and Sturge on the acclaimed Netflix series Midnight Mass.
